path.description: Database file path relative to the workspace root, for example data/shop.sqlite3. Absolute paths, '..' and links that leave the root are refused.

sql.description: Exactly one statement that starts with SELECT, WITH or VALUES. Use ? for values.

parameters.description: Values for the ? placeholders, in order.

max_rows.description: Return at most this many rows; more_rows says whether more exist.

time_limit_ms.description: Stop the work after this many milliseconds.

max_cell_chars.description: Longer text values are cut to this many characters and listed in shortened_cells.
